channel.title: All Game Jams on HK Oxalis Portfolio Website
channel.description: Recent content in All Game Jams on HK Oxalis Portfolio Website

item.title: Innsmouth Marine Biology
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: An horror mystery game made in Godot in 7 days in a group of three people. The code part was a pretty simple data-driven tree file structure, but I designed the UI for the fictional OS #, which I’m proud of.

item.title: Black Hole Billiards
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: An arcade-style game made in Godot in 4 days. I made all the visuals in shaders, which you can see in my main breakdown article. I’m happy with the gameplay too. One of my better jam results.

item.title: Forest Of The Night
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: A 3D platforming game made in 36 hours using Godot. I used free environment assets, but because they were high-def, I lost time optimising them for web. The core look still works alright on PC.

item.title: Bubble Solution
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: A puzzle-platformer made in a group of six in Unreal Engine 5 in 3 days. This was my first time as the least experience member of a team, and I learned a lot from watching everyone else.

item.title: A Relaxing Autumn Drive
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: A cozy driving game made using Godot in 3 days. I tried using Blender’s geometry nodes for the environment, but misunderstood the exporting process, resulting in very poor performance.

item.title: Petals in the Wind
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: A system-based minigame made solo using Godot in 3 days about growing flowers to score points. It has problems with font scaling, but the core data-based programming architecture worked well.

item.title: Still Life In Two Dimensions
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: A creepy puzzle game made alongside a composer using Unity in 10 days. The puzzles were a bit too hard, but I like the visual effect of the pressed flowers.

item.title: Go Up
item.author: HSFK2017@gmail.com (H K)
item.description: An atmospheric visual novel made solo in Ren’Py in 7 days. My first foray into game-making, but I’m proud of the museum scene.
